verdict.rationale: Grafana documents its own collector, Grafana Alloy, for sending logs and database metrics and logs. It also offers first-party Kubernetes Monitoring and AWS/Azure/GCP cloud-provider monitoring, and a community user confirms shipping k8s logs to hosted Loki. However, host and container instrumentation are not explicitly documented, and the Kubernetes and cloud evidence describes monitoring views rather than how the agent or integration is installed. missing for 10: explicit host and container instrumentation via Alloy or integrations, documentation of the Kubernetes and cloud-service integration setup or agent deployment, independent corroboration of breadth.
